subject: Question about group argument in BYM2 model

messages.author: 9a5b747b943f32d3
messages.subject: Question about group argument in BYM2 model
parts:
Hi, 

I’m having trouble understanding how the grouping structure works for the BYM2 model, notably which precision matrix is involved in the Kronecker product. 

Specifically, I am not sure if the grouping structure applies only to the (scaled) Besag component, if it applies to both the Besag and unstructured components, or if it applies to the whole effect (i.e., equation 7 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/1601.1180)? 

Best,
Olivier

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Question about group argument in BYM2 model
parts:
I agree, as the 'group' does not know about the special structure for the bym2,
and will group the whole model, not just the spatial part. You may do that
'manually' by gruop-ing besag model directly and then add idd
